intro: Look-into shortlist for the Scotland opener (EDI land → Dundee night 1 → Glasgow nights 2–3). Starred properties advertise an airport shuttle (EDI or GLA). Confirm shuttle hours and fees before booking — not reservations. Photos are look/atmosphere references (not official booking gallery shots).

cities.role: Landing, car pickup Day 1, and car drop Day 2 afternoon.

hotels.name: Holiday Inn Express Edinburgh Airport
hotels.why: 24-hour shuttle to EDI stance 10; useful if you overnight near the airport before the car loop or after drop-off.
hotels.shuttle_note: Paid return shuttle (~£2.50 adult); ticket at reception.

hotels.name: DoubleTree by Hilton Edinburgh Airport
hotels.why: Airport-area full service with parking; good backup if Express is full.
hotels.shuttle_note: Hotel-run EDI shuttle — confirm schedule when booking.

hotels.name: The Balmoral Hotel
hotels.why: Classic city base steps from Waverley — great for Edinburgh pins, not for airport logistics.
hotels.shuttle_note: No hotel airport shuttle; Airlink 100 / taxi to EDI.

hotels.name: Premier Inn Edinburgh City Centre (Princes Street)
hotels.why: Reliable midscale near Old Town pins; walkable to Waverley for the Glasgow train.

cities.role: Night 1 after St Andrews / Fife — ~1 hour from EDI; expect self-drive or taxi, not an airport shuttle.

hotels.name: Malmaison Dundee
hotels.why: Waterfront stay after the Fife loop; walkable restaurants.

hotels.name: Apex City Quay Hotel & Spa
hotels.why: Quayside base with parking for the rental car overnight.

hotels.name: Premier Inn Dundee Centre
hotels.why: Straightforward midscale with parking near the V&A / city pins.

cities.role: Nights 2–3 after evening ScotRail from EDI — no car in the city. Prefer centre hotels; star GLA-shuttle options only if you need an airport overnight.

hotels.name: Holiday Inn Express Glasgow Airport
hotels.why: Starred for airport access — short walk to GLA; useful only if flying out of Glasgow, not for the city stay.
hotels.shuttle_note: On-airport / walk-to-terminal; confirm any shuttle vs walk on booking.

hotels.name: Glynhill Hotel & Spa
hotels.why: Near GLA with parking packages that include long-stay + shuttle to terminal.
hotels.shuttle_note: Shuttle typically via airport long-stay package — confirm with hotel.

hotels.name: Kimpton Blythswood Square Hotel
hotels.why: Strong centre base for Glasgow pins after the EDI train — no car needed.
hotels.shuttle_note: No hotel GLA shuttle; taxi or Airport Express bus.

hotels.name: CitizenM Glasgow
hotels.why: Compact modern rooms near Central / Queen Street for day-3 walking.
